name: Project Forge
content: An AWS instance ticketing system for a large telecommunications company. This is my first project as a developer where I learned most the fundamentals of web development and microservices.

name: Project Occupy
content: An internal desk reservation system project built in Angular and Springboot. This is where I practiced my front-end development skills since this application is UI/UX intensive.

name: HealthNow + KMD Integration
content: Enabled HealthNow to access the video conference services of KonsultaMD through API integration. This is where I learned API communication concepts such as OAuth2, JWT and FeignClient.

name: BDO CMS
content: BDO Cash Management System (CMS) is a standalone API catered for corporate data of BDO Southbound APIs. This API accepts aggregated requests and communicates with BDO’s core banking system. As the main developer of this API, I implemented multithreading via Java’s concurrency library to optimize the API’s performance.

name: BDO PMR
content: BDO Prepaid Mobile Reload (PMR) is also a standalone API which acts as an intermediary microservice between BDO’s Airtime Reload (ATR) system and Paymaya API. As the main developer, my objective is to create a passthrough API that facilitates the flow of reload transactions between BDO and Paymaya. This is where I extensively used Docker for containerization and got familiar with deployment processes.

name: Sandstone Technology
content: Sandstone offers loan origination products such as LendFast and Apply, which are applications that are much larger in scope compared to the ones I handled before. Thus, I work with a team and my job involves mostly of bug fixing and implementing features requested by client bank. I learned how larger enterprise systems operate and was able to work with developers both local and foreign.
